channels.name: Bus A (primary)
channels.purpose: Primary 78 Ω twinax bus carrying Manchester II 1.0 Mbit/s; one BC + up to 31 RTs share it.
channels.physical_realization: Twinax cable (Zo 70-85 Ω, 78 Ω nominal); transformer-coupled or direct-coupled stubs; ≥ 75 % shielded bus couplers; terminated at both ends in Zo.

channels.name: Bus B (redundant)
channels.purpose: Standby 78 Ω twinax bus identical to Bus A; used for retry / failover; messages travel on only one of A/B at a time.
channels.physical_realization: Same construction as Bus A; independent run + terminators.

handshake_pairs.name: COMMAND_TO_STATUS
handshake_pairs.rule: RT responds with Status Word 4-12 µs after the last command word; broadcast (RT addr 31) suppresses Status.

handshake_pairs.name: SERVICE_REQUEST_TO_VECTOR
handshake_pairs.rule: RT sets Service Request bit in Status Word; BC issues Transmit Vector Word (Mode Code 10000) to acquire the request data.

handshake_pairs.name: DYNAMIC_BUS_CONTROL
handshake_pairs.rule: Mode Code 00000; backup RT/BC acknowledges with Dynamic Bus Acceptance bit (Status Word bit 15).

handshake_pairs.name: BIT_WORD_PROBE
handshake_pairs.rule: BC issues Transmit BIT Word (Mode Code 10011); RT returns Status + 1 Data Word.

dependency_graph.command_response: Every BC Command Word must be followed by exactly one RT Status Word (per addressed RT) within 4-12 µs, except broadcast (no Status).
dependency_graph.data_word_ordering: For BC→RT: BC's Data Words follow the Command Word immediately. For RT→BC: RT's Data Words follow its Status Word immediately. For RT→RT: source RT's Data Words follow its Status; destination RT's Status follows.
dependency_graph.redundant_bus_select: Per-message: BC chooses Bus A or Bus B before transmitting; the other bus is electrically idle for that message.

logical_signal_states.name: Manchester logical 1
logical_signal_states.rule: First half-bit (0.5 µs) HIGH, second half-bit (0.5 µs) LOW. Mid-bit falling edge.

logical_signal_states.name: Manchester logical 0
logical_signal_states.rule: First half-bit (0.5 µs) LOW, second half-bit (0.5 µs) HIGH. Mid-bit rising edge.

logical_signal_states.name: Command/Status sync
logical_signal_states.rule: HIGH 1.5 µs then LOW 1.5 µs over a 3 µs sync field; unambiguously marks a Command or Status Word.

logical_signal_states.name: Data sync
logical_signal_states.rule: LOW 1.5 µs then HIGH 1.5 µs over a 3 µs sync field; unambiguously marks a Data Word.

logical_signal_states.name: Bus idle
logical_signal_states.rule: No Manchester transitions; inter-message gap ≥ 4 µs.

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: WORD_SYNC
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 3 µs non-Manchester; HL = Command/Status; LH = Data

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: SUBADDRESS_OR_MODE
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 5 bits; 0 or 31 routes to Mode Code

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: PARITY
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 1 bit odd parity over 16 data bits

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: MESSAGE_ERROR_BIT
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 1 bit in Status Word; RT signals command-side error

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: SERVICE_REQUEST_BIT
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 1 bit in Status Word; RT requests acyclic transfer

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: BUSY_BIT
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 1 bit in Status Word; RT cannot service this cycle

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: SUBSYSTEM_FLAG_BIT
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 1 bit in Status Word; subsystem-level fault

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: TERMINAL_FLAG_BIT
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 1 bit in Status Word; RT-internal fault

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: DYNAMIC_BUS_ACCEPTANCE
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 1 bit in Status Word; ACK to Dynamic Bus Control mode code

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: BROADCAST_COMMAND_RECEIVED
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 1 bit in Status Word; RT acknowledges last command was broadcast

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: INSTRUMENTATION_BIT
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 1 bit in Status Word; reserved / instrumentation use

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: INTER_MESSAGE_GAP
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: ≥ 4 µs of bus quiet between messages

frame_fields_as_signal_segments.name: RT_RESPONSE_GAP
frame_fields_as_signal_segments.form: 4-12 µs from end of last command word to start of RT Status Word

ordering_rules.within_a_message: Command Word always first (BC source); Status Word follows after response gap; Data Words flow either before (BC→RT) or after (RT→BC) the Status Word.
ordering_rules.global_ordering: BC's schedule is deterministic (cyclic-executive frames at typically 50 / 25 / 12.5 Hz minor rates); acyclic transfers slot into reserved slots after Service Request.
